maddeler.e:
انحذفت (form VII)
# اِنْحَذَفْتُ (inḥaḏaftu) /in.ħa.ðaf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْحَذَفَ (inḥaḏafa)
# اِنْحَذَفْتَ (inḥaḏafta) /in.ħa.ðaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْحَذَفَ (inḥaḏafa)
# اِنْحَذَفْتِ (inḥaḏafti) /in.ħa.ðaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْحَذَفَ (inḥaḏafa)
# اِنْحَذَفَتْ (inḥaḏafat) /in.ħa.ða.fat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
